pages.title: Yinming and the Nether River
pages.text: This page follows yin_underworld_cluster.json, yin_luo_hall.json, and secret_realms.json#nether_river_land. The Netherworld is not one complete primary dimension, but a cluster formed by Yinming, the Nether River secret realm, and pocket dimensions.

pages.title: Entry Routes
pages.text: Yinming is the introductory region for ghost cultivators and requires the ghost path plus Qi Refining. The Nether River requires Foundation Establishment and a ghost-path quest and includes a ferryman. Current content provides yinming events, the yin-stone item, and records for both regions.

pages.title: Yin Luo Hall
pages.text: Yin Luo Hall is the Netherworld's demonic ghost-path hub. Its method is yin_luo_ghost_art and its currency yin_stone. Reputation titles range from Wandering Soul Guest to Outer Hall Disciple and may later unlock soul-banner crafting; hostile tags include orthodox sects and pure-yang cultivators.

pages.title: Environmental Risks
pages.text: Global rules include a daylight debuff for ghost cultivators and bonus pure-yang damage. The Nether River can also mitigate yin-aligned tribulations. These are currently mostly guide and event hooks; ferry fares, yin damage, soul banners, ghost quests, cleansing, and resistance systems remain unimplemented.
